note: The main menu as data (MainMenu builds it; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Main menu'). Tabs in order; each page lists blocks by kind, and each kind has one builder in src/app/menu/main_menu.gd. Exams are not listed here: they are discovered from the question bank ('exam' label, grouped by the label without its '#N'). Exam format numbers come from data/exam_blueprint.json, the edition from data/edition.json. {edition}, {items}, {minutes}, {pass}, {n}, {count}, {area} are filled in by the builder. study_tools loads entry_script by path and calls its static hooks (attach, question, answered, back) only if they exist, so the menu runs with or without the math tools.
